cause: Training/serving skew on a log transform. Joining the two feature groups on entity_id in Hopsworks, features f1, f3, f4, f5 match exactly (correlation 1.0, zero difference) on the 200 shared entities, while f2 diverges. The relationship is exact: train.f2 = log1p(serve.f2) (equivalently serve.f2 = expm1(train.f2)), with max residual ~6e-7. So the training pipeline applied a log1p (natural-log-of-1-plus) transform when computing f2, but the online serving path serves the raw, un-log-transformed value. The model therefore sees raw-scale f2 at inference but log-scale f2 in training.
